title: OpenClaw Morning Briefing: Wake Up to a Full Daily Digest on Telegram
summary: Set up an OpenClaw morning briefing on Telegram in 15 minutes. Get calendar, email, weather, and news before you open your laptop — your agent runs it at 7am every day.
body_markdown:
Here's the problem with running OpenClaw on your laptop: your agent only fires the 7 AM cron if your laptop is on at 7 AM.


Close the lid, shut it down overnight, or lose WiFi — no briefing.


This is where most self-hosted setups quietly break. You set up the cron, go to sleep, wake up, nothing in Telegram.


**Blink Claw solves this.** Your agent runs 24/7 on managed infrastructure — even when your laptop is off. The 7 AM cron fires from your agent's own private cloud machine. You get the message on your phone whether you're home, traveling, or still asleep.


No Docker setup. No VPS to manage. No separate API keys for each model — choose from 13 AI models, with usage billed from your workspace credits. From about $45/month per agent.


To migrate your existing OpenClaw setup to Blink Claw:


```text
# Export your current config
openclaw   export   --output   my-agent-config.json


# Import on Blink Claw (run from the Blink Claw dashboard)
blink   claw   import   --config   my-agent-config.json
```


Your cron jobs, channel connections, and HEARTBEAT.md all transfer.
